Rewrite of the original 3C-5 pilot, approved by the site owner after review of the drafted text. Same approved angle (henderson-jurisdiction) and the same four SUPPORTED Henderson Municipal Code claims, plus business claims from the shared ledger. Two factual corrections to the previously published text were the main reason for re-approval: the 72-hour allowance is stated with both of its conditions (a single vehicle registered to a resident of the property, undergoing minor repair) rather than as a general grace period, and screening is stated as a condition on vehicles already within the permitted count rather than a way to exceed it. Restores the section photography and nearby-areas block that the first promotion dropped. NRS 487.290 remains deliberately absent - it is a high-risk regulatory claim resting on a secondary publisher.

Re-bound again to 63523aee after correcting the alt text on all three section photographs. The originals described images that had been specified but not looked at: the 'driveway' photo is a pickup truck at the kerb rather than a sedan on a driveway, and the 'situations' photo shows a car already strapped to a flatbed rather than being winched onto one. A confidently wrong description is worse than none for a screen-reader user. Alt text only; prose, claims and structure unchanged.
